name: Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025
information: ## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Rubik's UK Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025) #### As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's UK Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! The podiummers will be crowned during the awards ceremony in Birmingham* Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU1MTQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cef753cc0422223e223e2696d2d751a45d058f8b/UKC25_LOGO_-_FOR_WCA_WEBSITE.jpg)
